name: strategic-explainer-fast
description: Turn source-grounded technical results into concise, human-readable explanations in the current context without spawning a subagent.

interface.shortDescription: Explain technical results clearly without a subagent.
interface.longDescription: Strategic Explainer Fast is a standalone read-only communication skill for one real user-facing comment, report, blocker explanation, final, or explicit editing request. It works directly in the current agent context without spawning a subagent, separates current authoritative sources from inherited process history, reconstructs the reader's core question, preserves material facts and uncertainty, removes internal identifiers and mixed-language jargon, and returns publication-ready text plus a separate source basis. It intentionally does not claim the clean-context or independent-reader guarantees of ordinary Strategic Explainer. It does not choose scope or status, make authority decisions, mutate systems, or bundle connectors.
defaultPrompt: Объясни этот технический результат простым языком без отдельного субагента, сохранив суть и границы
Перепиши этот комментарий без воды и внутренних ID, не потеряв важные факты
Составь понятное объяснение блокировки и следующий наблюдаемый шаг без запуска субагента
